home.hero_subtitle: Understand agent harness architecture from scratch, one mechanism at a time
home.core_pattern_desc: DeepSeek Harness uses an everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis. Every part, including the model adapter and agent loop, is a replaceable plugin.
home.learning_path_desc: 10 progressive sessions, from plugin foundation to event system
home.layers_desc: Nine orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent harness
home.architecture_desc: Nine layers compose into a complete agent harness. Each layer builds on the one below it.

timeline.title: Learning Path
timeline.subtitle: s01 to s10: Progressive Harness Architecture

layers.architecture: The foundation. Cordis plugin system where everything is a replaceable plugin.
layers.data: Session log and durable facts. Append-only event storage.
layers.core: The agent loop. Turns, steps, and lifecycle management.
layers.execution: Tool and shell execution. Scoped registries and providers.
layers.design: Capability seams. Service Definition → Provider → Consumer pattern.

session_details.s01_desc: Cordis provides the everything-is-a-plugin architecture. No privileged core — every part is replaceable.
session_details.s02_desc: Append-only event log that serves as the source of truth. Everything the model sees must be reconstructable from it.
session_details.s03_desc: Turn/step lifecycle management. A step is one model request plus tools; a turn groups steps into coherent work.
session_details.s04_desc: Scoped tool registry with pre/post execution pipeline. Tools are registered with guards for validation.
session_details.s05_desc: Three-role pattern: Service Definition, Service Provider, Consumer. Swapping one provider changes the whole product.
session_details.s06_desc: LLM adapter seam with message vocabulary and streaming. Providers register adapters for actual API calls.
session_details.s07_desc: Shell execution capability with local, remote, or sandboxed providers sharing one interface.
session_details.s08_desc: Subagent capability seam for delegation. Child agents get clean context while preserving the main thread.
session_details.s09_desc: Profile composition system where bundles stack in order. Each layer can patch the config below it.
session_details.s10_desc: Typed event map with waterfall semantics. Listeners must call next() to delegate, otherwise they short-circuit.
